entities.name: Sarpadian Mountains
entities.description: A range on the north coast of Sarpadia, home of a lost dwarven empire.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Region of Dominaria containing the mountains.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Vast southern range where dwarves continued to live.

entities.name: Dwarven empire of the Sarpadian Mountains
entities.description: Dwarven empire whose name was lost after orcs and goblins destroyed it.

entities.name: Kaylen
entities.description: Dwarf hero killed in combat by an orc.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Kaylen's lover who fled and sought her brother.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker whose rise was set in motion by Tymolin's search.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Fall of the empires of Sarpadia.

events.summary: Orcs and goblins destroy the dwarven empire; the dwarf hero Kaylen is killed by an orc.
participants: Dwarven empire of the Sarpadian Mountains
